question: What does the ‘Print Range’ option allow you to do when printing a document?

options.text: Add header and footer information to the printed pages
Choose the specific pages or range of pages to be printed
Adjust the size of the printed document to fit on a specific number of pages
Print the document with different fonts and styles

solution:
The correct answer is __**Choose the specific pages or range of pages to be printed**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Print Range** option allows you to **specify which pages of a document** you want to print. 
 
• This is useful if you only need to print a few pages of a document, or if you want to print a specific section of a document.
 
• For example, if you have a 10-page document and you only want to print pages 5-7, you would use the Print Range option to specify pages 5-7. The printer would then only print pages 5-7 of the document.
 
• The Print Range option is typically available in the print settings dialog box of most printing applications. 
 
• The specific location of the option may vary depending on the application, but it is usually found in a section labeled "Pages" or "Print Range".
